label: Qwen Image Edit
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 edit of one frame by a text prompt, with up to 3 reference images. Output: the edited frame at plate size.

output.tooltip: Qwen works on display-referred (sRGB Texture) images, so values above 1.0 are clipped. Comp the edit back over the plate only where it changed.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: The edit instruction. The plate is <image1>; the ref2-ref4 inputs are <image2>-<image4>.

knobs.name: refine_prompt
knobs.label: refine prompt
knobs.tooltip: Let the Qwen prompt enhancer rewrite the instruction first (slower, usually better). Turns on its thinking pass too.

knobs.name: resolution
knobs.label: resolution
knobs.tooltip: Pixel budget (aspect kept). 0 = the plate's own size; up to 2048 (use 2048 for 4K plates). The result is scaled back to plate size.

knobs.name: cfg
knobs.label: cfg
knobs.tooltip: Keep 1 (official). Raise it only together with a negative prompt.

knobs.name: negative_prompt
knobs.label: negative prompt
knobs.tooltip: Only used when cfg is above 1.
